column1: student|/ˈstuːdənt/|n.|学生；研究者|基础|study-people|a university student::大学生;a student of history::历史研究者|Every student received a copy of the timetable.::每个学生都收到了一份课程表。|She is a careful student of local history.::她是一位细致研究地方史的人。
